content.json:
# AI FinOps — Foundry Agents
Token usage, estimated cost, chargeback and health for the demo agents.

_Estimated cost uses gpt-5-mini GlobalStandard list price ($0.25/1M input, $2.00/1M output) — a token-derived estimate; reconcile with Azure Cost Management._
## Cost & chargeback
**Estimated cost by agent:** prompt and completion tokens, call count and estimated USD per agent; your chargeback breakdown.
**Cost share by agent:** each agent's slice of estimated spend, so the biggest driver stands out.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok), calls=count() by agent | extend est_usd=round(prompt/1000000.0*0.25 + completion/1000000.0*2.00,4) | order by est_usd desc
content.title: Estimated cost by agent

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok) by agent | extend est_usd=round(prompt/1000000.0*0.25 + completion/1000000.0*2.00,4) | project agent, est_usd | order by est_usd desc
content.title: Cost share by agent

content.json: **Cost per successful request:** estimated USD divided by successful calls; the real unit cost of a useful answer.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok), total=count(), ok=countif(success==true) by agent | extend est_usd=round(prompt/1000000.0*0.25 + completion/1000000.0*2.00,4), success_rate=round(100.0*ok/total,1) | extend usd_per_success=round(iff(ok>0, est_usd/ok, real(null)),6) | project agent, total, ok, success_rate, est_usd, usd_per_success | order by usd_per_success desc
content.title: Cost per successful request

content.json: **Daily estimated cost trend:** estimated spend per day; watch for spikes or a creeping climb.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) | summarize completion=sum(outTok), calls=count() by bin(timestamp, 1d) | extend est_usd=round(0 + completion/1000000.0*2.00,4) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Daily estimated cost trend

content.json: ## Token usage
**Tokens by agent:** prompt vs completion tokens; completion is 8x pricier here, so it drives cost.
**Completion tokens per hour:** hourly volume per agent, revealing load patterns and busy periods.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok) by agent | order by completion desc
content.title: Tokens by agent (prompt vs completion)

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize completion=sum(outTok) by bin(timestamp, 1h), agent | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Completion tokens per hour by agent

content.json: ## Health & efficiency
**Latency percentiles:** p50, p95 and p99 per agent; the p95/p99 tail is what users actually feel.
**Truncated-response rate:** share cut off by the token cap (finish_reason = length); high means raise max_tokens or trim prompts.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize p50_ms=round(percentile(duration,50),0), p95_ms=round(percentile(duration,95),0), p99_ms=round(percentile(duration,99),0), calls=count() by agent | order by p95_ms desc
content.title: Latency percentiles by agent (ms)

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']), fr=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.response.finish_reasons']) | summarize total=count(), truncated=countif(fr has 'length') by agent | extend truncated_pct=round(100.0*truncated/total,1) | project agent, total, truncated, truncated_pct | order by truncated_pct desc
content.title: Truncated-response rate (finish_reason = length)

content.json: **Cached-input token ratio:** percent of input served from prompt cache and the estimated saving; higher is cheaper.
**Routed model distribution:** which model the router picked and its cost share; cheap models should handle easy prompts.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), cached=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cached_input_tokens']), agent=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']) | summarize input=sum(inTok), cached=sum(coalesce(cached,0)) by agent | extend cached_pct=round(100.0*todouble(cached)/iff(input>0,input,1),1) | extend est_savings_usd=round(todouble(cached)*(0.25-0.03)/1000000.0,4) | project agent, input, cached, cached_pct, est_savings_usd | order by cached_pct asc
content.title: Cached-input token ratio by agent

content.query: dependencies | where tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'])=='model-router' | extend routed=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.response.model']), inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) | summarize calls=count(), input=sum(inTok), output=sum(outTok) by routed | as T | extend pct_calls=round(100.0*calls/toscalar(T|summarize sum(calls)),1), est_cost_usd=round((input*0.25+output*2.0)/1000000.0,4) | project routed, calls, pct_calls, input, output, est_cost_usd | order by calls desc
content.title: Model router - routed model distribution

content.json: **Tool error rate:** calls and failure rate per tool; stays empty until tool-using agents run.

content.query: dependencies | where tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name'])=='execute_tool' or isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.tool.name'])) | extend tool=tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.tool.name']) | summarize calls=count(), failures=countif(success==false), avg_ms=round(avg(duration),0) by tool | extend error_rate_pct=round(100.0*failures/calls,1) | project tool, calls, failures, error_rate_pct, avg_ms | order by error_rate_pct desc, calls desc
content.title: Tool error rate (empty until tool-using agents run)

content.json:
## Provisioned Throughput (PTU) break-even
**PTU = reserved capacity billed at a fixed hourly rate no matter how many tokens you send; consumption (pay-go) is billed per token.** This tile takes the agents' *measured* token volume in the selected time range, projects it to a full day, and asks: *at this volume, would a PTU reservation be cheaper than pay-go?*

Set **PTU reserved** and **USD per PTU-hour** below, then read the row:
- **tokens_per_day** — current volume projected to 24h.
- **breakeven_tokens_day** — the volume where PTU and pay-go cost the same. Below it → consumption wins; above it → PTU wins.
- **consumption_usd_day** — projected pay-go cost/day at current volume.
- **ptu_usd_day** — fixed PTU cost/day = PTU × hourly rate × 24 (paid even at zero traffic).
- **verdict** — which option is cheaper right now.

_Estimate only: PTU has per-deployment minimums (often 15–50 PTU) and monthly/annual reservations are cheaper than hourly. Short sampling windows extrapolate aggressively — widen the time range for a stable number._

**Setting the _USD per PTU-hour_ value** (enter a plain number, no $): it's what you pay to reserve one PTU for one hour, which depends on the billing model — reservations are far cheaper than hourly:
- **Hourly (no commitment):** ~1.0
- **Monthly reservation:** ~0.35 (= $ per PTU-month ÷ 730)
- **Annual reservation:** ~0.30 (= $ per PTU-year ÷ 8760)

Rates vary by model and deployment type (Global / Data Zone / Regional Provisioned) and change over time — confirm on the Azure OpenAI pricing page or your EA/CSP price sheet. The default **1.0** is the worst-case (hourly); if consumption still wins at 1.0 it wins even harder at reservation rates._
**PTU vs consumption break-even:** at the measured volume, compares pay-go against a PTU reservation and flags the cheaper option.

content.query: dependencies | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name'])) | extend inTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), outTok=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) | summarize prompt=sum(inTok), completion=sum(outTok), firstT=min(timestamp), lastT=max(timestamp) | extend windowHours=max_of(todouble(datetime_diff('second', lastT, firstT))/3600.0, 1.0), total_tokens=prompt+completion, consumption_usd=prompt/1000000.0*0.25 + completion/1000000.0*2.00 | extend tokens_per_day=round(total_tokens/windowHours*24,0), consumption_usd_day=round(consumption_usd/windowHours*24,2), ptu_usd_day=round(toreal({PTU_Count})*toreal({PTU_HourlyUSD})*24,2), price_per_token=consumption_usd/iff(total_tokens>0,total_tokens,1) | extend breakeven_tokens_day=round(ptu_usd_day/iff(price_per_token>0,price_per_token,1.0),0), verdict=iff(consumption_usd_day>=ptu_usd_day,'PTU cheaper at current volume','Consumption cheaper — stay pay-go') | project tokens_per_day, breakeven_tokens_day, consumption_usd_day, ptu_usd_day, verdict
content.title: PTU vs consumption break-even

content.json:
## Semantic cache (AI gateway)
APIM LLM **semantic caching** on the citadel gateway serves repeated/rephrased prompts from Redis instead of re-billing the model. Each **hit** is one model call — and its tokens — avoided. Metrics come from the `emit-metric` in the cache policy (namespace `semantic-cache`), landing in the gateway's Application Insights.

_Empty until the `cache-demo` API receives traffic (run `demo/semantic-caching/demo-semantic-cache.ps1`)._
**Cache hit-rate and calls avoided:** hits, misses and hit-rate; every hit is one model call (and its tokens) saved.
**Cache hit-rate over time:** hourly hit-rate; it climbs as the cache warms up with repeated questions.

content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'SemanticCache' | extend result = tostring(customDimensions.result) | summarize cache_hits = sumif(valueCount, result == 'hit'), cache_misses = sumif(valueCount, result == 'miss'), total_requests = sum(valueCount) | extend hit_rate_pct = round(100.0 * cache_hits / total_requests, 1), model_calls_avoided = cache_hits | project total_requests, cache_hits, cache_misses, hit_rate_pct, model_calls_avoided
content.title: Cache hit-rate & model calls avoided

content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'SemanticCache' | extend result = tostring(customDimensions.result) | summarize hits = sumif(valueCount, result == 'hit'), total = sum(valueCount) by bin(timestamp, 1h) | extend hit_rate_pct = round(100.0 * hits / total, 1) | project timestamp, hit_rate_pct | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Cache hit-rate over time (%)

content.json: **Hits vs misses:** proportion of gateway requests served from cache versus forwarded to the model.

content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'SemanticCache' | extend result = tostring(customDimensions.result) | summarize requests = sum(valueCount) by result | order by requests desc
content.title: Hits vs misses
